title: NeuroMorph: A High-Temporal Resolution MEG Dataset for Morpheme-Based Linguistic Analysis
description: NeuroMorph is a magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset with high temporal resolution, designed for morpheme-based linguistic analysis. It contains recordings from 24 participants, totaling over 17 hours of data, acquired with a 208-channel KIT/Yokogawa magnetometer system. The dataset supports research on the neural processing of morphology during language comprehension.
methods_description: Data were recorded with a KIT/Yokogawa MEG system with 208 magnetometer channels from 24 subjects, with visual presentation of linguistic stimuli. Supplementary code is available on GitHub.

funding_references.funder_name: New York University Abu Dhabi Institute
